scope: Authored private StandaloneWindows focus and end-edit compatibility for the shipped Save Preset name field. Native save, listing and named load request pass; exact visual morph reapplication remains unproven.

observed_state.visible_state: blank horizontal dark rectangle with no prompt, text, or visible caret
observed_state.focus_v1_result: Caret appeared and PreservationTest was entered successfully.

static_cause.behavior: Disables the main EventSystem GameObject and activates the InputField GameObject.
static_cause.missing_behavior: Does not select the field or call InputField.ActivateInputField.
static_cause.first_selected_timing: The dedicated PC save EventSystem is already active while its first-selected InputField GameObject is inactive, so its initial first-selection attempt is not a reliable activation path and is not retried by Show.
static_cause.blank_visual_explanation: The field intentionally has empty text and no placeholder; without activation it has no caret. Escape has no SavePresetName cancel handler.
static_cause.end_edit_compatibility_inference: The 2021 runtime declares m_OnSubmit at offset 0x130 with FormerlySerializedAs aliases including m_OnEndEdit, and declares the callback invoked by DeactivateInputField separately as m_OnDidEndEdit at offset 0x138. The 2018 asset type tree names its listener m_OnEndEdit. The trace proves deactivation without OnSavePreset, supporting—but not independently proving until retest—that the legacy event did not populate the runtime m_OnDidEndEdit slot.

authored_patch.policy: Append exactly one third persistent Button call after SavePresetName.Show and migrate the sole legacy InputField end-edit type-tree field to the 2021 runtime field name.
authored_patch.focus_proof: Show synchronously activates the field and disables the main EventSystem. ActivateInputField sets the next-update activation flag. ActivateInputFieldInternal then uses the still-active EventSystemPCSavePreset, selects GameObject 5152, and enables in-place keyboard editing and caret state.
authored_patch.why_main_event_system_is_not_reactivated: A dedicated active PC save EventSystem already exists. Reactivating the main one would create competing active EventSystems and is unnecessary.

end_edit_type_tree_migration.status: V2 native save, list and named load request pass. This supports the compatibility inference; exact visual morph reapplication remains unproven.

normal_actions_after_patch: Select Save Preset and press Return.
Press Return to end the single-line edit.
InputField onEndEdit invokes SavePresetName.OnSavePreset, which rejects only an empty name, hides the field, restores selection after one frame, and calls ManagerPreset.Save with the current gender.

controller_text_entry.platform_guard: Returns without opening Sony IME when DialogPS4.isPC is true.
controller_text_entry.title: Save Preset
controller_text_entry.note: PreservationTest is 16 characters and fits the controller IME limit. The StandaloneWindows Button instead uses the local InputField persistent-call flow.

historical_focus_only_copy.runtime_result: Focus, caret, and text entry passed; end-edit callback did not invoke OnSavePreset.

actions: Pressed Return; the name panel closed and the editor resumed.
Opened the preset list; Default and PreservationTest were visible.
Selected PreservationTest; the named native load request was served.
v2_runtime_result.load_request_shape_verified_without_iden: current session GUID, current platform account ID, preset GUID, numeric gender 0, PreservationTest, StandaloneWindows

persistence_checkpoint.observation: A male PreservationTest preset exists and its stored b73 value is 100; the Default preset b73 value is 0.

screenshots.observation: Preset list visibly contains Default and PreservationTest.

v2_runtime_result.boundary: The named save, durable listing, and named load request are proven. The tester perceived a possible height change after load but could not confirm it, so exact visual morph reapplication is not claimed.

limitations: The V2 end-edit migration is runtime validated for focus, text entry, Return close, native save, durable listing, and named load request.
Exact visual morph reapplication after the load remains unproven.
Reconnect persistence was not separately retested in a fresh process during this bounded run.
The bundle rewrite preserves every other raw object/resource payload but not the original compressed byte layout.
